items.title: FBI warns about Kimsuky hackers using QR codes to phish U.S. orgs
items.description: The North Korean state-sponsored hacker group Kimsuki is using malicious QR codes in spearphishing campaigns that target U.S. organizations, the Federal Bureau of Investigation warns in a flash alert. [...]

items.title: xAI teases major Grok upgrade, hints at Grok Code CLI
items.description: Elon Musk-backed xAI has been missing in action for a while now, but today, Musk teased a major upgrade for Grok alongside new products. [...]

items.title: Maximum Severity HPE OneView Flaw Exploited in the Wild
items.description: Exploitation of CVE-2025-37164 can enable remote code execution on HPE's IT infrastructure management platform, leading to devastating consequences.

items.title: Fake AI Chrome Extensions Steal 900K Users' Data
items.description: Threat actors ripped off a legitimate AI-powered Chrome extension in order to harvest ChatGPT and DeepSeek data before sending it to a C2 server.

items.title: VMware ESXi zero-days likely exploited a year before disclosure
items.description: Chinese-speaking threat actors used a compromised SonicWall VPN appliance to deliver a VMware ESXi exploit toolkit that seems to have been developed more than a year before the targeted vulnerabilities became publicly known. [...]
